scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/src/sidepanel/index.html')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/src/sidepanel/index.html', 'dist/sidepanel.html'); if (fs.existsSync('public/icons')) fs.cpSync('public/icons', 'dist/icons', { recursive: true });"
